content:
Use an uploaded character sheet as a strict visual reference to keep the main character consistent across the entire Seedance 2.5 clip.  
Write timecoded shot blocks (e.g., [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) to control pacing and ensure specific actions happen at exact moments in a 15-second video.  
Specify camera/coverage per beat (wide, extreme close-up, overhead, side profile) and explicitly request “different angle every cut” to force varied shot composition.  
Call out persistent visual constraints like “timer always visible somewhere in the frame” to maintain continuity of key props across cuts.  
Direct motion emphasis by stating the focal subject (“hands are always the focus”) and adding motion descriptors (“moving so fast they blur”) to push speed/blur effects.  
Include an AUDIO section with explicit sound progression (near silence → music builds → loudest timer slam → crowd eruption) to shape the clip’s sound design.  
Force a dynamic opening by prompting “starts mid action frame one” so the video begins already in motion rather than establishing shots.  
Lock the look by stacking style keywords (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) and add negative constraints (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

es.content:
Usa una hoja de personaje subida como referencia visual estricta para mantener al personaje principal consistente en todo el clip de Seedance 2.5.  
Escribe bloques de plano con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) para controlar el ritmo y asegurar que acciones específicas ocurran en momentos exactos en un video de 15 segundos.  
Especifica la cámara/cobertura por beat (plano general, primerísimo primer plano, cenital, perfil lateral) y solicita explícitamente “different angle every cut” para forzar una composición de planos variada.  
Señala restricciones visuales persistentes como “timer always visible somewhere in the frame” para mantener la continuidad de los props clave entre cortes.  
Enfatiza el movimiento indicando el sujeto focal (“hands are always the focus”) y añadiendo descriptores de movimiento (“moving so fast they blur”) para potenciar los efectos de velocidad/desenfoque.  
Incluye una sección AUDIO con una progresión sonora explícita (casi silencio → la música crece → golpe del timer al máximo volumen → estallido de la multitud) para dar forma al diseño sonoro del clip.  
Fuerza una apertura dinámica con el prompt “starts mid action frame one” para que el video comience ya en movimiento en lugar de con planos de establecimiento.  
Fija el estilo apilando palabras clave de estilo (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) y añade restricciones negativas (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

fr.content:
Utilisez une fiche de personnage téléchargée comme référence visuelle stricte afin de conserver la cohérence du personnage principal sur l’ensemble du clip Seedance 2.5.  
Rédigez des blocs de plans horodatés (par ex. [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) pour contrôler le rythme et garantir que des actions précises se produisent à des moments exacts dans une vidéo de 15 secondes.  
Précisez la caméra/le cadrage pour chaque temps fort (plan large, très gros plan, vue plongeante, profil latéral) et demandez explicitement « different angle every cut » pour imposer une composition de plans variée.  
Signalez les contraintes visuelles persistantes comme « timer always visible somewhere in the frame » afin de maintenir la continuité des éléments clés d’un plan à l’autre.  
Mettez l’accent sur le mouvement en indiquant le sujet focal (« hands are always the focus ») et en ajoutant des descripteurs de mouvement (« moving so fast they blur ») pour accentuer les effets de vitesse et de flou.  
Incluez une section AUDIO avec une progression sonore explicite (quasi-silence → la musique monte → le plus fort coup de timer → explosion de la foule) pour façonner le sound design du clip.  
Forcez une ouverture dynamique en demandant « starts mid action frame one » afin que la vidéo commence déjà en mouvement plutôt qu’avec des plans d’établissement.  
Verrouillez le rendu en empilant des mots-clés de style (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) et ajoutez des contraintes négatives (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

ja.content:
アップロードしたキャラクターシートを厳密なビジュアル参照として使用し、Seedance 2.5 のクリップ全体を通してメインキャラクターの一貫性を保ちます。  
タイムコード付きのショットブロック（例: [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]）を記述して、テンポをコントロールし、15秒の動画の中で特定のアクションが正確なタイミングで起こるようにします。  
各ビートごとにカメラ／画角を指定し（wide、extreme close-up、overhead、side profile など）、さらに「different angle every cut」と明示的に要求して、ショット構成に変化を持たせます。  
「timer always visible somewhere in the frame」のような継続的な視覚制約を明記し、カットをまたいでも重要な小道具の連続性を維持します。  
焦点となる被写体（「hands are always the focus」）を明示し、「moving so fast they blur」のような動きの描写を加えて、スピード感やモーションブラー効果を強調します。  
AUDIO セクションを含め、明確な音の展開（near silence → music builds → loudest timer slam → crowd eruption）を指定して、クリップのサウンドデザインを形作ります。  
「starts mid action frame one」と促してダイナミックな冒頭を強制し、動画が導入ショットではなく、すでに動きの中から始まるようにします。  
スタイルキーワードを重ねてルックを固定し（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain）、さらに否定条件（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar）を追加します。

ko.content:
업로드한 캐릭터 시트를 엄격한 비주얼 레퍼런스로 사용해, 전체 Seedance 2.5 클립에서 메인 캐릭터의 일관성을 유지하세요.  
시간 코드가 포함된 샷 블록(예: [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05])을 작성해 페이싱을 제어하고, 15초 영상의 정확한 순간마다 특정 동작이 일어나도록 하세요.  
비트마다 카메라/커버리지(wide, extreme close-up, overhead, side profile)를 지정하고, “different angle every cut”를 명시적으로 요청해 컷마다 다양한 샷 구성을 강제하세요.  
“timer always visible somewhere in the frame”처럼 지속적으로 유지되어야 하는 시각적 제약을 명시해, 컷이 바뀌어도 핵심 소품의 연속성을 유지하세요.  
집중 대상 피사체(“hands are always the focus”)를 명시하고, 속도/블러 효과를 강화하기 위해 동작 묘사(“moving so fast they blur”)를 추가해 모션의 강조점을 직접 지정하세요.  
AUDIO 섹션을 포함해 명시적인 사운드 진행(near silence → music builds → loudest timer slam → crowd eruption)을 적어 클립의 사운드 디자인을 구성하세요.  
“starts mid action frame one”이라고 프롬프트해 다이내믹한 오프닝을 강제하여, 영상이 설정 샷 없이 이미 움직이는 상태에서 시작되도록 하세요.  
스타일 키워드(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain)를 겹쳐서 룩을 고정하고, 부정 조건(not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar)을 추가하세요.

pt.content:
Use uma ficha de personagem enviada como referência visual rigorosa para manter o personagem principal consistente ao longo de todo o clipe do Seedance 2.5.  
Escreva blocos de cena com timecode (por exemplo, [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) para controlar o ritmo e garantir que ações específicas aconteçam em momentos exatos em um vídeo de 15 segundos.  
Especifique a câmera/cobertura por batida (wide, extreme close-up, overhead, side profile) e solicite explicitamente “different angle every cut” para forçar uma composição de planos variada.  
Aponte restrições visuais persistentes como “timer always visible somewhere in the frame” para manter a continuidade de props-chave entre os cortes.  
Destaque o movimento direcionando a ênfase para o sujeito focal (“hands are always the focus”) e adicionando descritores de movimento (“moving so fast they blur”) para intensificar efeitos de velocidade/desfoque.  
Inclua uma seção AUDIO com progressão sonora explícita (near silence → music builds → loudest timer slam → crowd eruption) para moldar o design de som do clipe.  
Force uma abertura dinâmica com o prompt “starts mid action frame one” para que o vídeo comece já em movimento, em vez de usar planos de estabelecimento.  
Trave o visual empilhando palavras-chave de estilo (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain) e adicione restrições negativas (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

zh.content:
使用上传的角色设定图作为严格的视觉参考，确保主角在整个 Seedance 2.5 片段中保持一致。  
写出带时间码的镜头块（例如 [0:00-0:02]、[0:02-0:05]），以控制节奏，并确保在 15 秒视频中的特定时刻发生指定动作。  
为每个节拍明确指定镜头/取景方式（wide、extreme close-up、overhead、side profile），并明确要求“different angle every cut”，以强制使用多样化的镜头构图。  
指出持续性的视觉约束，例如“timer always visible somewhere in the frame”，以保持关键道具在不同镜头之间的连贯性。  
通过说明焦点主体（“hands are always the focus”）并添加运动描述（“moving so fast they blur”）来强调动作，推动速度/运动模糊效果。  
加入一个 AUDIO 部分，并明确声音推进（near silence → music builds → loudest timer slam → crowd eruption），以塑造片段的声音设计。  
通过提示“starts mid action frame one”来强制一个动态开场，让视频一开始就处于运动中，而不是从建立镜头开始。  
通过叠加风格关键词（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain）来锁定整体视觉效果，并添加负面约束（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar）。
